questions.q: How does Unity Catalog capture data lineage?
options: Automatically, down to the column level, from queries run through Spark DataFrame or Databricks SQL interfaces
Only when a user manually draws a lineage diagram in Catalog Explorer
Only for tables explicitly tagged 'lineage-tracked'
Only for data ingested through Delta Live Tables
questions.explain: Lineage is captured automatically from real query activity against Unity Catalog tables — no manual diagramming or tagging is required.

questions.q: In the lineage graph, what does clicking the icon on a connecting edge (rather than a node) open?
options: A Lineage details panel showing the source, target, and what produced that specific connection
A dialog to delete that table
The table's row filter configuration
A prompt to rename the connected tables
questions.explain: Clicking an edge opens the Lineage details panel, which names the specific notebook, job, or query that created that connection and what downstream assets depend on it.

questions.q: What does column-level lineage show that table-level lineage doesn't?
options: Only the exact upstream columns that actually contributed to one selected column, not every column in every connected table
The dollar cost of each table in the lineage graph
Which users have SELECT permission on each table
The exact row count of every table in the chain
questions.explain: Clicking a specific column highlights only the columns genuinely feeding it, which is far narrower (and more useful for a wide table) than the full table-to-table graph.

questions.q: What minimum permission does a user need on a table's parent catalog to view that table's lineage?
options: BROWSE
MODIFY
OWNERSHIP
No permission is required — lineage is visible to all authenticated users
questions.explain: A user needs at least BROWSE on the parent catalog to view lineage; tables they can't access appear only as masked, unexpandable nodes.

questions.q: Which system tables expose Unity Catalog's lineage graph as queryable SQL?
options: system.access.table_lineage and system.access.column_lineage
system.billing.usage and system.billing.list_prices
system.compute.warehouses and system.compute.clusters
system.data_classification.results
questions.explain: system.access.table_lineage and system.access.column_lineage expose the same lineage data shown in the UI graph, queryable as plain SQL for repeatable, scheduled compliance checks.
